title: DONALDSON Co INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Donaldson Company, Inc. entered into a $400 million three-year committed, unsecured, delayed draw term loan credit facility with Wells Fargo as administrative agent. The facility was available as of April 8, 2026, with no amounts drawn at inception. Interest rates are priced at Term SOFR or Base Rate plus an applicable spread tied to the company's debt-to-EBITDA ratio. Financial covenants require a minimum interest coverage ratio of 3.5x and maximum adjusted debt-to-EBITDA of 3.5x.
key_points: Donaldson Company (DCI, NYSE) established a $400 million three-year unsecured delayed draw term loan facility on April 8, 2026
No amounts were outstanding under the facility as of April 8, 2026
Term SOFR-based loans carry a zero percent floor; Base Rate loans also have a zero percent floor
Applicable rate spread is calculated based on the company's debt-to-EBITDA ratio
Covenants require minimum interest coverage ratio of 3.5:1 and maximum adjusted debt-to-EBITDA of 3.5:1
Wells Fargo Bank and U.S. Bank National Association served as joint lead arrangers
